unauthenticated: Your session ended. Please sign in again.
forbidden: You don't have permission to do that.
not_found: The item doesn't exist or you can't access it.
conflict: An item with the same details already exists.
rate_limited: Too many attempts. Please wait a moment and try again.
already_member: This email already belongs to a member of the organization.
invitation_invalid: This invitation link is invalid or was already used.
invitation_expired: This invitation has expired. Ask for a new one.
last_super_admin: You can't remove the last Super Admin.
cannot_deactivate_self: You can't deactivate your own account.
cannot_modify_self: You can't change your own access.
cannot_grant_unheld_permission: You can't grant permissions you don't have.
role_locked: This role is locked; its permissions can't be changed.
role_in_use: This role is assigned to members. Unassign it first.
file_too_large: The file is larger than allowed.
unknown: Something unexpected happened. Please try again.
last_client_owner: The company must keep at least one active owner.
invalid_transition: The request can't move to that status from its current one.
invalid_assignee: The request can't be assigned to this person.
request_field_restricted: You can't change this part of the request.
request_type_inactive: This request type isn't available right now. Refresh and choose another type.
reason_required: Add a reason so the client knows why.
dependency_cycle: This dependency would create a loop.
invalid_dependency: That task can't be linked — it must belong to the same client.
version_empty: Add at least one file (or the copy text) before sending for review.
version_locked: This version was sent for review and can't change. Upload a new version.
version_not_current: A newer version exists. Refresh the page.
comment_required: Add your feedback so the team knows what to change.
status_in_use: Tasks still use this status. Move them to another status first.
status_done_required: Keep at least one status in the "Done" category.
already_converted: This request was already converted into tasks.
invalid_parent: That task can't be a subtask here.
invalid_file: That file can't be used here.
report_published: This report is published. Move it back to draft to edit it.
import_empty: The file has no days with numbers we can import.
campaign_not_deletable: Only draft or archived campaigns can be deleted.
channel_has_metrics: A channel with recorded numbers can't be removed. Keep it, or clear its numbers first.
invalid_stage: That stage doesn't belong to this pipeline.
deal_not_won: Mark the deal as won first.
already_converted_deal: This deal was already turned into a client.
onboarding_not_configured: Set the onboarding request type and workflow in Sales settings first.
onboarding_not_permitted: Your role can't start this onboarding workflow. Ask an account manager, or turn off onboarding and convert the request from the inbox later.
integration_not_configured: This platform isn't configured on the server yet (app keys are missing).
integration_auth_failed: The platform refused or expired the authorization. Reconnect and try again.
integration_permission_denied: The connected account doesn't have the required permissions on the platform.
integration_rate_limited: The platform is limiting requests right now. Try again shortly.
integration_unavailable: Couldn't reach the platform. Try again shortly.
connection_not_connected: The connection is not active. Reconnect it first.
channel_client_mismatch: The selected channel belongs to a different client than the ad account.
invalid_phone: That phone number can't receive WhatsApp messages.
template_not_approved: This template isn't approved by WhatsApp.
no_phone: There is no mobile number to send the message to.
webhook_url_blocked: This address is not allowed (it must be a public HTTPS URL).
ai_disabled: AI is switched off for your agency. An admin can turn it on in AI settings.
ai_not_configured: AI isn't set up yet: the provider keys are missing.
ai_budget_exceeded: Your agency has used this month's AI budget. An admin can raise it in AI settings.
ai_refused: The AI model declined this request. Try rephrasing it.
ai_unavailable: The AI service didn't respond. Try again in a moment.
in_use: It's still in use, so it can't be deleted. The dialog lists what uses it.
reassign_required: Choose who takes over this person's open work first.
parent_deleted: Restore the item it belongs to first — it's in the Trash too.
reset_locked: Data reset is locked. A Super Admin can unlock it with their password.
field_forbidden: You can't change this field on this task. Account managers, team leads and admins can; you can update the status and checklist of tasks assigned to you.
ai_key_invalid: The provider rejected this API key. Check it and try again.
email_in_use: Another account already uses this email.
email_invalid: This email address can't receive mail. Check it and try again.
email_send_failed: The confirmation email couldn't be sent (mail server error). Try again later or contact your administrator.
email_not_resendable: Sign-in and invitation links aren't kept, so this email can't be resent. Ask the person to request a new link.
